description: Operator breakdown of decode at n=1..16 via jax.profiler, to test whether anything moves discontinuously at n=4 (review Q2). The roofline answered the bandwidth/MFU half offline; this is the half that needs a profiler.
note_workload: Matches m9_roofline's source workload (256/64) so the operator breakdown and the roofline describe the same steps.
note_warmup: Each cell is run once untraced before tracing, so XLA compilation for that shape is not inside the trace.
